question: Bhim walks 5 m towards west from his house, then he turns left and walks 50 m, then he turns right and walks 30 m to reach his school. In which direction is his school from his house? (All the turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**The given information can be represented as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6df30ae6a7aafc7a3f1a259dafb652c71b74387307e572e381b48a02ece0aca3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13b083076cc97d5118e6c990793b42f81d663b5f1aeb0da613af8d0600cebf36.png] 

Bhim school is in **South-west** direction from his house.

Hence, the correct answer is **"South- West".**
